steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for technology in everyday life. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | French Exam Tips — Technology in Everyday Life: 1. For Technology in Everyday Life, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3. In translation tasks, translate meaning rather than word-for-word 4. When writing about Technology in Everyday Life, include opinions and justifications, not just descriptions 5. For listening and reading, focus on key words and cognates to extract meaning
